title: Akbar ki naujawani
body:
akbar ki naujawani asghar ki bezubani
ek gham ki daastan hai ek dard ki kahani
<<DIVIDER>>
pabandiya hazaro aayad kare zamana
roke na ruk sakegi askhon ki ye rawani
akbar ki naujawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekaar koshishe hai matam ko rokne ki
matam sada rahega ye gham hai kya ledani
akbar ki naujawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
har waaqeya hai jiska dooba hua lahoo may
dunya bhula sakegi kis tarha wo kahani
akbar ki naujawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
le kar chale hai sarwar asghar ko ran ki jaanib
shayad pilaade koi do ghoont isko pani
akbar ki naujawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam tod te hai akbar ran may tadap tadap kar
parwaan chad rahi islam ki jawani
akbar ki naujawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
bole hussain ya rab jaata hai ab wo marne
husn o shabab may jo ahmed ki hai nishani
akbar ki naujawani...
